1522: He wore a pretty large wig, which had once been white, but was now of a brownish yellow; his coat was one of those modest coloured drabs which mock the injuries of dust and dirt; two jackboots concealed, in part, the well mended knees of an old pair of buckskin breeches, while the spotted handkerchief round his neck, preserved at once its owner from catching cold, and his neck cloth from being dirtied.
